documents.heading: General overview, establishment, location, approval and philosophy
documents.text: Adani Institute of Digital Technology Management (AIDTM) was established in 2020 and is located in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India. The supplied profile describes it as an AICTE-approved private institute. Its core philosophy is inspired by the Adani Group's ‘Nation Building’ and ‘Growth with Goodness’. AIDTM focuses on bridging innovative ideas and futuristic disruptive technologies, with particular emphasis on Big Data, Artificial Intelligence (AI), and Data Science.

documents.heading: Programs and courses offered
keywords: Executive Program in AI Analytics Automation
documents.text: AIDTM primarily offers two-year full-time postgraduate diploma programmes. PGDM (Big Data Analytics) is designed to teach Data Sciences, Statistical Learning, Data Visualization, SQL, Python, and Data-Driven Decision Making. PGDM (AI & Data Science) focuses on real-world problems using Machine Learning, IoT, Cloud Computing, Generative AI (Gen-AI), Robotic Process Automation (RPA), Natural Language Processing (NLP), and Data Engineering. The Executive Program in AI, Analytics & Automation (EPAAA) is for working professionals.

documents.heading: Admissions and eligibility criteria
documents.text: The supplied profile lists eligibility as a bachelor's degree in BE/B.Tech, B.Sc, BCA, MCA, or M.Sc from a recognised university, with a minimum of 50% marks (45% for reserved categories). Final-year students can apply. Accepted entrance exams listed are CAT, XAT, CMAT, MAT, ATMA, and GMAT. Work experience is not mandatory, though relevant experience carries weight. Selection weightage: Personal Interview (PI) 40%; entrance exam score 20%; academic performance 20%; work experience 10%; extracurriculars 10%. Confirm current criteria and selection rules with the official admission page.

documents.heading: PGDM fee structure and application fee
documents.text: The supplied profile lists the total two-year PGDM programme fee as ₹10,00,000. The caution deposit is ₹50,000 and is refundable, so total payable to the institute is ₹10,50,000. The application fee is ₹1,500 and is non-refundable. Study materials, books, library and internet charges are included. Hostel, mess and living expenses are excluded. The supplied profile does not specify a complete instalment due-date schedule, so confirm current payment dates on the official admission page.

documents.heading: Placements, salaries, roles and recruiting sectors
documents.text: The supplied profile lists a 100% placement track record, highest salary (CTC) of ₹20 LPA, average salary (CTC) of ₹8 LPA, and 90% pre-placement offers (PPOs) through the five-month summer internship/capstone project. Roles listed include Data Analyst, Data Scientist, Business Analyst, Management Trainee (Digital Transformation), AI Strategies Manager, and Project Management Coordinator. Recruiting sectors listed include IT & Technology, Consulting, Ports & Logistics, Manufacturing, Healthcare, Financial Services, and FMCG. Treat placement figures as supplied information, not a guarantee of future outcomes; verify current reporting with AIDTM.

documents.heading: Curriculum, dual-degree advantage and practical immersion
documents.text: The supplied profile describes the PGDM programmes as integrated with a Diploma in Strategic Management, for example PGDM Big Data Analytics plus a Diploma in Strategic Management. It describes a five-month classroom phase and a five-month internship/capstone project, with an extensive 10-month continuous practical immersion alongside classroom modules. The academic framework connects physical processes and digital technologies, including IoT sensors, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, 5G and cloud infrastructure. EPAAA (Executive Program in AI, Analytics & Automation) is for working professionals solving real-world problems using advanced data methodologies.

documents.heading: Campus events and student life
documents.source_title: AIDTM campus life profile supplied for the chatbot
documents.text: The supplied profile lists Techathon as an annual technical event in January and Prashasti as an annual cultural event in January/February. Students take part in internal Ideathons, pitching startup and innovation ideas to judging panels. Student leadership includes nomination and voting for Batch Class Representatives. Other activities include regional events such as the Ahmedabad Marathon, cultural gatherings and DJ parties. Check current event dates with AIDTM.

documents.heading: Private student information and campus-service boundaries
documents.text: Public institutional information in this chatbot is based on the profile supplied for the project. This prototype does not connect to AIDTM's live student information, finance, admissions, ticketing, hostel or timetable systems. Individual student fee status and scholarship status are fictional local demo records available only to the authenticated demo student whose account owns the record. The bot must not invent a personal application status, marks, hostel allocation or another student's private information. Contact AIDTM for real student-specific information.
